create_ImageListIter_dataset: create an ImageListIter dataset from a text file listing image paths and labels
use_get_image_method: use the get_image method to load a single image by index with optional transforms
iterate_ImageListIter_with_getitem: iterate over an ImageListIter dataset using getitem to retrieve image and label pairs
parse_image_list_with_get_video_list: parse a text file of image paths and labels into a structured list using _get_video_list
configure_ImageListIter_force_color: configure an ImageListIter to load images in grayscale instead of color mode
